issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation 'sẽ ra thế nào' (what will happen/how will it be) changes the rhetorical structure. The Greek 'ο ασεβης και αμαρτωλος που φανειται' is a subject phrase ('the ungodly and sinful man who appears'), not a question about the outcome. The Vietnamese makes it a question of result, whereas the Greek sets up a contrast between two types of people.
